translations.web: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
translations.bsb: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
translations.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
translations.asv: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
